name: atomic-forager-draft-1
status: authored design, not a runtime specificity

listing.purpose: Try to consume the local ON cell.
Inspect one cell in the current heading.
If food was sensed ahead, retain the current heading.
Otherwise choose one heading; do not scan all neighbors.
Try to consume the destination cell, regardless of the earlier sensor result.
Read energy after feeding and maintenance.
If energy is positive, skip the death request.
Mark death pending; later child requests cannot override it.
Load the configured authored reproduction threshold.
Keep that threshold in the scratch register.
Read current energy for the reproduction comparison.
Set A to whether energy is below the saved threshold.
If below threshold, skip the child request.
Request reproduction; actual funding is checked by the world later.
Publish the pending request and start the next pass at position zero.
